items.title: Hackers Weaponizing Telegram Messenger with Dangerous Android Malware to Gain Full System Control
items.description: A sophisticated backdoor named Android.Backdoor.Baohuo.1.origin has been discovered in maliciously modified versions of Telegram X messenger, granting attackers complete control over victims’ accounts while operating undetected. The malware infiltrates devices through deceptive in-app advertisements and third-party app stores, masquerading as legitimate dating and communication platforms. With…
